Claim 1 (Currently amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor.

Claim 2 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

Claim 3 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

Claim 4 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

Claim 5 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

Claim 6 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

Claim 7 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

Claim 8 (Original): A physiological monitor comprising: a processor programmed to: trigger a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; send an output to a remotely located station, wherein the output triggers a second alarm in response to the alarm condition; and receive an input from the remotely located station, wherein the input causes physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm.

Claim 9 (Original): The physiological monitor of claim 8, wherein the processor is programmed to send an output to a wireless device when the escalated alarm is not acknowledged.

Claim 10 (Original): The physiological monitor of claim 8, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

Claim 11 (Original): The physiological monitor of claim 8, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

Claim 12 (Original): The physiological monitor of claim 8, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

Claim 13 (Original): The physiological monitor of claim 8, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

Claim 14 (Original): A method, comprising: triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; triggering a second alarm remote from the first location in response to the alarm condition; and escalating the first alarm if neither of the first or second alarms are acknowledged within a certain time.

Claim 15 (Original): The method of claim 14, wherein triggering the first alarm comprises triggering an inaudible alarm.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

Claim 17 (Original): The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Original): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

Claim 19 (Original): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

Claim 20 (Original): The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
